faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the BITS Pilani Visiting Faculty / Sr. Instructor / Instructor posts is 31st August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the positions of Visiting Faculty, Sr. Instructor, and Instructor in this BITS Pilani recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the BITS Pilani recruitment is strictly online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official portal before the closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Visiting Faculty positions?
faq.answer: For Visiting Faculty roles, a Ph.D. in relevant fields such as Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or AI/ML is generally required, depending on the specialization.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications for Sr. Instructor / Instructor roles?
faq.answer: For Instructor positions, a B.Tech. degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, while for Sr. Instructor roles, an M.Tech. degree in a similar discipline is necessary.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for BITS Pilani recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this BITS Pilani recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Visiting Faculty / Sr. Instructor / Instructor at BITS Pilani are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. In which state and city is this recruitment taking place?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for BITS Pilani in Karnataka, specifically located in Bengaluru.
